title: Here’s Where to Watch the Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills Game Live Online
summary: Livestream the Dolphins taking on the Bills on Sunday, Nov. 22 — plus, watch for a possible Hailee Steinfeld sighting at the game.
contentText:

For NFL week 11 , two AFC East teams battle each other to see which team is going to dominate the game. Plus, there might be one or two celebrity sightings during the game.

watch on Paramount+

How to Watch Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Nov. 22

- Network: CBS

- Matchup: Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Paramount+

When Does Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills Start ?

The NFL game takes place on Sunday (Nov. 22) with the Miami Dolphins (1-8) taking on the Buffalo Bills (8-1) at Highmark Stadium in Orchard Park, New York. Kickoff is at 1 p.m. ET/10 a.m. PT.

What TV Network Features Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills?

In 2026, the Dolphins-Bills game broadcasts on TV on CBS, while the game livestreams on Paramount+ .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills?

The NFL is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance during the game. Artists who have been known to appear at games in the past include Buffalo Bills fans Hailee Steinfeld (QB Josh Allen’s wife), Benny the Butcher, Westside Gunn and others.

Where to Watch Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch the NFL game if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services also offer free trials, so you can watch the game for free.
